title: UseGlobalOrSingleOrg is the shared strategy for 'global' routes that must respect single-org context
answers: Where is single-org-aware authorization implemented for otherwise-global admin routes?
What helper makes a route check current-org permissions instead of org 0 when SingleOrganization is enabled?
body: ac.UseGlobalOrSingleOrg(cfg) is the org-selection strategy passed into authorizeInOrg; it checks hs.Cfg.RBAC.SingleOrganization to decide whether to evaluate permissions against the caller's current org or the global org. It's already used by plugin management and Enterprise RBAC, and now also by /api/admin/users routes in pkg/api/api.go. New admin-style routes that should work for single-org Org Admins (without requiring global-scope grants) should use this same helper rather than ac.UseGlobalOrg.
applies: Any route registration in pkg/api that uses authorizeInOrg and needs single-org-aware permission checks

This helper checks `hs.Cfg.RBAC.SingleOrganization` to decide whether to evaluate permissions against the caller's current org or the global org. Already used by plugin management and Enterprise RBAC; now also applies to /api/admin/users routes. Constraint: use this instead of `ac.UseGlobalOrg` when the route should work for single-org Org Admins without requiring global-scope grants. Applies to route registrations in pkg/api that use `authorizeInOrg` and need single-org-aware permission checks.
